claims.statement: Decoration of the ceiling of a hall in the Sforza castle with interlaced trees. The work is dated by court correspondence to 1498.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Court correspondence; later restoration.
